items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: And, uh, Len's young brother Bob on, uh, Cornet was, uh, really, uh, sounded much like, uh, early Louis.

ctx.x: Well, what did Frank Johnson and Lynn Bernard play?

What approach did they turn? They were, uh, much looser. Um. Um. Still on a type of what is kick, but not, uh, not so much. Um. Len Bernard, uh, that, that was the Frank Johnson band. Len Bernard was, um, um, Louis Armstrong, Hot Five, Hot Seven band. Mm-hmm. Um. Um. And, uh, Len's young brother Bob on, uh, Cornet was, uh, really, uh, sounded much like, uh, early Louis. Too much, I suppose, but, uh, still it was nice to hear. Mm-hmm. Um. Um. Later, they, uh, they changed, brought in Ade Monsperum, uh, on alto,…
